req.title: Reject non-GET on /get
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 405 Method Not Allowed for any non-GET request to /get.

doc.reasoning: The requirement states that /get must accept GET requests (HTTP 200) and reject all non-GET methods with HTTP 405. The route is defined with methods=("GET",), so Flask will automatically return 405 for POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE, HEAD (non-standard), OPTIONS, etc. Tests cover: (1) positive EP — GET returns 200 with correct payload keys; (2) negative EP — POST returns exactly 405; (3) negative EP — PUT returns exactly 405; (4) negative EP — DELETE returns exactly 405; (5) negative EP — PATCH returns exactly 405; (6) boundary DT — all non-GET methods in a decision table; (7) BVA — status code is exactly 405, not 404 or 406. Each test asserts exact status codes to kill comparison-mutation operators.

tests.name: test_get_method_returns_200_with_expected_payload
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
Test client is created from app
expected: Response JSON contains keys: url, args, headers, origin
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_get_method_returns_200_with_expected_payload():
    r = client.get('/get')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = r.get_json()
    assert isinstance(data, dict)
    assert 'url' in data
    assert 'args' in data
    assert 'headers' in data
    assert 'origin' in data
    assert 'form' not in data
    assert 'data' not in data

tests.name: test_all_non_get_methods_return_exactly_405
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
Test client is created from app
actions: Send POST, PUT, DELETE, PATCH requests to /get
Assert each returns exactly 405 (not 404, not 406, not 400, not 200)
expected: All non-GET methods return HTTP 405 exactly
trace: R-HTTPBIN-003: boundary — status code must be exactly 405, catching off-by-one mutations (404, 406)
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_all_non_get_methods_return_exactly_405():
    methods = [
        client.post,
        client.put,
        client.delete,
        client.patch,
    ]
    for method_fn in methods:
        r = method_fn('/get')
        assert r.status_code == 405, f"Expected 405, got {r.status_code} for {method_fn}"
        assert r.status_code != 404
        assert r.status_code != 406
        assert r.status_code != 400
        assert r.status_code != 200

tests.name: test_get_returns_200_not_405
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
Test client is created from app
expected: HTTP 200 OK — GET is the only allowed method and must not be rejected
trace: R-HTTPBIN-003: boundary — GET must return 200, not 405; catches boolean-negation mutation on method check
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_get_returns_200_not_405():
    r = client.get('/get')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    assert r.status_code != 405
    assert r.status_code != 404
    data = r.get_json()
    assert data is not None
    assert set(['url', 'args', 'headers', 'origin']).issubset(set(data.keys()))

tests.name: test_decision_table_method_vs_status_code
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
Test client is created from app
actions: Build decision table: GET->200, POST->405, PUT->405, DELETE->405, PATCH->405
Execute each row and assert exact status code
expected: GET returns 200, all others return exactly 405
trace: R-HTTPBIN-003: DT — decision table covering all method/status combinations; kills comparison and constant mutations
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_decision_table_method_vs_status_code():
    table = [
        (client.get,    200),
        (client.post,   405),
        (client.put,    405),
        (client.delete, 405),
        (client.patch,  405),
    ]
    for method_fn, expected_code in table:
        r = method_fn('/get')
        assert r.status_code == expected_code, (
            f"{method_fn.__name__} /get: expected {expected_code}, got {r.status_code}"
        )
